meaning_description: CAEL stands for 'Come And Earn Literally'. The system can be referred to simply as Cael or Cael Hub.
creator: Caesar Augustus E. Literatus
mission: Empowering Every Dreamer to Build. To make powerful business technology accessible to everyone by providing free and affordable mobile applications, intelligent digital tools, and AI-powered assistance that help individuals and businesses turn their ideas into reality.
vision: A World Where Every Dream Has an Opportunity. To create a future where technology is no longer a barrier to entrepreneurship, where anyone — regardless of background or resources — has the opportunity to build, operate, and grow a successful business.

licensing_and_pricing: 100% Free Ecosystem. No monthly software licenses, no per-transaction platform royalties, and no user seat limits. Entrepreneurs can white-label with their own brand and logo.

partnership_model.tagline: YOUR BUSINESS. YOUR BRAND. OUR TECHNOLOGY.
partnership_model.subheading: Start Your Business. We'll Handle the Technology.
partnership_model.description: Launch your business with your own branded mobile application while Cael Hub takes care of the technology, maintenance, and infrastructure behind it.
what_you_get: 01. Your Own Brand: Use your company name and logo with a personalized application.
02. Your Own Business App: Get access to a business application without upfront software licensing or development fees under our partnership.
03. Free Software Maintenance: Enjoy ongoing updates, bug fixes, and eligible personalization at no additional development fee.
04. Managed Infrastructure: We handle your application's servers, database, hosting, and maintenance.
05. Google Play Store Management: We manage publishing and eligible app updates so you can focus on your business.
partnership_model.service_share: A Simple 2% Service Share: Cael Hub automatically receives an agreed 2% share of your business's collected service fee on each eligible transaction (e.g. if you collect a 15% service fee, Cael Hub's share is deducted automatically from that fee). This covers hosting, database management, software maintenance, and technical support.

whats_included_breakdown.closing_statement: All Cael Hub applications come with 100% free white-label deployment, source code customization, and zero ongoing licensing fees.

answers.source_code: Yes, 100% full source code access for both client applications and backend APIs, giving entrepreneurs total control to customize business logic and integrations.
answers.white_label_logo: Yes, complete white-label branding freedom. You can use your own company name, logo, custom color scheme, app icons, and custom domain with zero Cael Hub watermarks.
answers.deployment_assistance: Yes, guided onboarding documentation, step-by-step launch checklists, and direct CAELIN AI deployment assistance are included.
answers.hosting_and_third_party: Software and code are 100% free with zero licensing fees. You maintain direct account ownership of your chosen cloud hosting and third-party APIs (Google Maps, SMS, payment gateways), paying raw provider costs with zero markup from us.
answers.setup_and_maintenance_costs: Zero setup fees and zero ongoing licensing fees (₱0 / $0 forever). No monthly software fees, no royalties on your revenue, and no vendor lock-in.
